technologyStack.backend: ASP.NET Core Web API 7.0, MediatR, CQRS, C#

architectureAndDesignPatterns: Clean Architecture with 4 concentric layers (Domain -> Application -> Infrastructure -> Api)
CQRS pattern utilizing MediatR requests and notifications
Angular Standalone Component architecture with inject()-based DI and Signal/RxJS state
solidPrinciples: Single Responsibility: Separate Command Handlers, Query Handlers, and Validators into distinct classes
Open/Closed: Extend pipeline behaviors via MediatR IPipelineBehavior
Interface Segregation: Small, focused abstractions (IIdentityService, IJwtTokenService)
Dependency Inversion: High-level application modules depend on interfaces in Application/Domain
cleanCodeStandards: Asynchronous I/O (async/await, CancellationToken) through all controller-to-database chains
Encapsulate domain invariants inside Domain Entities
Thin API controllers delegating directly to MediatR pipeline
securityPractices: Sanitize and validate inputs using FluentValidation before handlers
Automated account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts for 15 minutes
Generic anti-enumeration error messages on authentication failures
HMAC-SHA256 signed JWT tokens with claims and expiration
